description_en: Retrieves the evaluation report of a specified compliance package within a specified account group
description_zh: 获取指定账号组内指定合规包的评估报告
kebab_example: aliyun config get-aggregate-compliance-pack-report --compliance-pack-id cp-fdc8626622af00f90000 --aggregator-id ca-f632626622af00790000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAggregateCompliancePackReport

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package ID.

For information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain the account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the management account to which the compliance package belongs
AccountId.description_zh: 合规包归属的企业管理账号ID

ReportCreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp when the compliance package evaluation report was created. Unit: milliseconds
ReportCreateTimestamp.description_zh: 创建合规包评估报告的时间戳。单位：毫秒

ReportStatus.description_en:
The status of the compliance package evaluation report. Valid values:
NONE: Not created.
CREATING: Being created.
COMPLETE: Complete
ReportStatus.description_zh:
合规包评估报告的状态。取值：
NONE：未创建。
CREATING：创建中。
COMPLETE：完成

ReportUrl.description_en: The download URL of the compliance package evaluation report
ReportUrl.description_zh: 合规包评估报告的下载地址
